run_train_meru_model: run the MERU model training script with a config file and optional GPU count
run_train_with_resume: run the training script with resume flag to continue from the last checkpoint
run_train_distributed: run distributed training across multiple GPUs and machines using the train script
run_train_with_overrides: run the training script with config overrides passed as command line key-value pairs
run_train_with_checkpoints: run the training script with a custom checkpoint saving period in iterations
